parameters.operation: SELECT id, title, content, stage, urgency, importance, due_date, estimated_duration, blocks_others, affected_areas, last_opened, created_at FROM para_items WHERE stage IN ('jots', 'tasks', 'projects') AND (last_score_update IS NULL OR last_score_update < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour')

INSERT INTO task_scores (item_id, score, color_code, score_breakdown, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) ON CONFLICT (item_id) DO UPDATE SET score = EXCLUDED.score, color_code = EXCLUDED.color_code, score_breakdown = EXCLUDED.score_breakdown, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at
UPDATE para_items SET last_score_update = $1 WHERE id = $2
